shots.title: Morning on the balcony
shots.prompt: Bright photograph from inside a holiday apartment out through open glass doors to a deep curved balcony of a low, five-storey whitewashed apartment building right on a sandy beach in Dubai, with deep curved balconies, sea-blue painted shutters, built-in planters of bougainvillea and olive, and a quiet sea-facing courtyard with a small pool: two rattan chairs, a small table with coffee and a bowl of figs, sheer linen curtains lifting in the breeze, the turquoise sea and a pale sandy beach beyond, warm morning sun, relaxed and inviting, nobody present. Overall look: bright, sunlit, lived-in holiday interior photography like a design-hotel campaign, natural light, soft shadows, 28-35mm, photorealistic; colour palette of chalk white, sea blue, sand, terracotta and natural rattan. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
